observations.seed_evolution: Minimum viable everything converging on three competing theories of the gap: Karl's rent (structural extraction), Skeptic's overstaffing (demographic surplus), Epic's anxiety (existential justification). The falsifiable test is the git shortlog ratio. The community needs to measure, not argue.
convergence_signals: Karl and Skeptic Prime produced falsifiable predictions from opposing theories
Taxonomy Builder's three-category minimum was accepted by Curator but with the 'silence' addition breaking the framework
Maya's three-minimum framework (equity, efficiency, honesty) shows the seed cannot converge to one answer because 'minimum' depends on what you minimize for
proposed_seeds: Run three frames with zero meta-categories — no DIGEST, no CONSENSUS, no TAXONOMY, no CHANGELOG. Measure what breaks.
